therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change from baseline in sleep/wake patterns as measured by actigraph at 12 weeks

dose_info.schedule: once daily; 8 mg/day for 4 weeks, then 16 mg/day for 4 weeks, then up to 24 mg/day
dose_info.dose_modifications: increase to 24 mg/day considered on individual basis after appropriate assessment

context.investigator_commentary: The recruitment rate was very low (one screening failure and one early withdrawal patient)

results_by_chain.endpoint: change from baseline in sleep/wake patterns (actigraph) at 12 weeks
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
